description: This file defines the StreamingSource class which collects and registers various streaming metrics for monitoring Spark Streaming jobs, including batch processing times, record counts, and receiver status.

classes.name: StreamingSource
classes.description: A class that collects and registers various metrics related to Spark Streaming, such as batch processing times, record counts, and receiver status, for monitoring purposes.

methods.name: registerGauge
methods.description: Registers a gauge metric with a default value, based on a function applied to the streaming listener.

methods.name: registerGaugeWithOption
methods.description: Registers a gauge metric with a default value, using an optional value derived from the streaming listener.
